SOLICITAÇÃO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE

 

1 COORDENADOR EPIDEMIOLÓGICO DAS ANTENAS

 

CONSULTORIA INDIVIDUAL

 

HEPRR/C-035

 

País: Angola

Nome do Projecto: Projecto de Preparação, Resposta e Resiliência a Emergências de Saúde em Angola (HEPRR)

Título de Contracto: Contratação de Serviços de Consultoria

Empréstimo No.: 9562-AO

RFP Referência No.: HEPRR-AO/C-035

O Governo de Angola recebeu uma doação no valor equivalente de USD 1.9 milhões de Dólares Norte Americanos, com o Banco Internacional de Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (BIRD) do Grupo Banco Mundial, para a implementação do Projecto de Preparação, Resposta e Resiliência a Emergências de Saúde em Angola (HEPRR) e pretende aplicar parte dos recursos na contratação de um (1) COORDENADOR EPIDEMIOLÓGICO DAS ANTENAS

O objectivo geral desta consultoria visa apoiar o planeamento, a implementação e a monitoria dos processos de aquisição de bens, obras e serviços do Projeto HEPRR, assegurando a conformidade com a Legislação Nacional de Contratação Pública de Angola e com o Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers do Banco Mundial, de modo a garantir eficiência, transparência, economia e boa gestão dos recursos do projeto.

A consultoria terá a duração de nove (9) meses, renováveis em função do desempenho satisfatório, da disponibilidade financeira e das necessidades do projecto. Os termos de referência podem ser obtidos no endereço electrónico abaixo indicado.

O Projecto de Preparação, Resposta e Resiliência a Emergências de Saúde em Angola (HEPRR), convida por este meio os consultores individuais ("Consultores") elegíveis a manifestarem o seu interesse em prestar os Serviços. Os consultores interessados deverão fornecer informações que demonstrem que possuem as qualificações requeridas e experiência relevante para executar os serviços, submetendo o seu curriculum vitae, certificados/diplomas académicos, comprovativos de experiência profissional e outros documentos de suporte que se achem necessários para a candidatura.

O(A) Consultor(a) deverá possuir as seguintes qualificações:

Formação Académica

  • Ser médico, licenciado ou técnico superior em área de saúde relevante, com mestrad ou  pós-graduação em Epidemiologia, Saúde Pública ou Gestão de Saúde;
  • Habilitações mínimas ao nível de pós-graduação em Saúde (Epidemiologia de Campo seria o ideal) ou outra área de Saúde Pública;

Experiência Profissional

  • Conhecimento da língua portuguesa e capacidade de se comunicar e escrever em língua inglesa ou francesa, será uma vantagem;
  • Oferecer as garantias de moralidade requeridas para o exercício das funções;
  • Experiência profissional de, pelo menos, IO anos (após a obtenção do diploma).
  • Conhecimento comprovado do Sistema e estruturas do Serviço de Saúde, incluindo familiaridade com politicas demais documentos normativos Ministério da Saúde e organizações internacionais no âmbito da Saúde.
  • Experiência e competências comprovadas na utilização de diferentes softwares para análise de dados.

Os consultores serão avaliados com base nas Normas e Regulamentos de Aquisições do Banco Mundial para Mutuários de Financiamentos de Projectos de Investimento de Setembro de 2023, pelo que deverão ter em atenção à Secção III, parágrafos 3.14, 3.16, e 3.17 das referidas Normas, que definem a política do Banco Mundial sobre o conflito de interesses. O referido documento pode ser consultado na seguinte hiperligação:

https://thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/6c0602876d68949e80820507d90a14ed-0290012023/original/Procurement-Regulations-September-2023.pdf.

O(A) Consultor(a) será selecionado com base no método de contratação de Consultores Individuais de acordo com as Normas e Regulamentos de Aquisições em vigor (Setembro 2023).

Os Consultores interessados poderão obter informação adicional, incluindo os TORs (Termos de Referência) no endereço abaixo indicado de Segunda Feira à Sexta Feira entre as 8H00 – 15H00.

As manifestações de interesse (Curricula, cópia dos certificados de habilitações académicas, avaliação de desempenho e outra informação pertinente) deverão ser enviadas até ao dia 27 de Março de 2026 às 15H00 (Horário de Angola).

procnotices.notice_text:
Request for Expression of Interest (REOI)

 

COUNTRY:                              Republic of Lebanon

PROJECT NAME:                    Fiscal Management Project (FMP)

CONSULTING SERVICES:       Procurement Specialist

DUTY STATION:                     Ministry of Finance  

  1. The Government of Lebanon has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Fiscal Management Project (FMP). The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is seeking to use part of the proceeds of the funds to finance the position of the Procurement Specialist.

 

  1. The Procurement Specialist will have the primary responsibility to support the implementation of all procurement activities under the FMP, including ensuring that procurement processes are conducted in accordance with World Bank procurement regulations and that procurement activities are aligned with the project implementation schedule.

 

  1. Responsibilities: The Procurement Specialist will support the preparation and updating of the project procurement plan and ensure its alignment with the implementation schedule. The role includes preparing bidding documents, requests for proposals, and other procurement documentation required for the acquisition of goods, works, and consulting services under the project. The Procurement Specialist will coordinate the procurement process from preparation through evaluation and contract award, ensuring compliance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers. The position also involves maintaining procurement records, supporting contract management, monitoring procurement progress, and providing advice to the Project Coordination Unit (PCU) and the Ministry of Finance on procurement-related matters. Across all these functions, the Procurement Specialist will uphold compliance with World Bank policies, transparency principles, and anti-corruption guidelines while supporting effective coordination with project stakeholders. All other tasks detailed in the Terms of Reference (TOR) that will be provided upon request by E-mail.

 

  1. Duration: The assignment will be for a period of twelve (12) months with the possibility of extension subject to satisfactory performance and availability of fund for the duration of the project.

 

  1. Selection Criteria: The selection shall be based on the qualifications, experience and skills of the candidate and followed by an interview. The qualifications, experience and skills should include:  
    • Bachelor’s degree in procurement, engineering, economics, business administration, or related field; Master’s is an asset.
    • Professional procurement certification (e.g., CIPS or equivalent) and experience with complex ICT/enterprise systems procurements are strong assets.
    • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in implementing procurement actions according to international guidelines or regulations such as the World Bank or any other multilateral development organization.
    • Solid understanding of World Bank Procurement Regulations and familiarity with STEP.
    • Proven experience in goods, works, and consultancy procurement, including contract management.
    • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
    • Excellent communication skills in English and Arabic (French is an advantage).  Proficiency in Microsoft Office and procurement-related software tools.
  2. The MOF now invites eligible Individual Consultants to indicate their interest in providing the above-mentioned services.  Interested consultants must provide information indicating that they are qualified to perform the Services and furnish the Curriculum Vitae (CV) and their motivation letter.  

 

  1. The attention of interested consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s ‘Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers’ July 2016 revised November 2017, August 2018, November 2020, September 2023; February 2025 and

September 2025 [Procurement in investment Project Financing; Goods, Works, NonConsulting and Consulting Services], setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

 

  1. A consultant will be selected in accordance with the procedures set out in the World Bank’s ‘Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers’ July 2016 revised November 2017, August 2018, November 2020, September 2023, February 2025 and September 2025 for selection of individual consultant.

 

  1. Interested Consultants may obtain further information at the address given below from 9:00 to 14:00 Hrs on working days (Monday through Friday.)

 

  1. Deadline for submission: The Expression of Interest (EOI) and the CV completed in the prescribed form must be delivered to the address below (in person, or by mail) by March 31st, 2026, at 14:00 Hours (Beirut Time) 

 

  1. Further details of this REOI are provided in the Terms of Reference (TOR), which may be obtained upon request in person or by e-mail to the address given below. Application through e-mail is highly encouraged.

 

Attention: 

Ministry of Finance

CORRIGENDUM

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REOI)

Reference is invited to REOI published by WAPDA regarding hiring of consulting firms for “Socio Economic Assessments on Priority E&S Aspects” under the Building Environmental & Social Capacity (BESC) project under a World Bank grant.

It is hereby notified that the deadline for submission of EOIs has been extended till 31.03.2026 up to 1200 Hours and opening is scheduled on the same day at 1230 Hours. All other terms and conditions of the REOI shall remain unchanged.

Water and Power Development Authority (WAPDA) has received financing from the World Bank (Grant No. TF0C9206) toward the Building Environmental and Social (E&S) Capacity (BESC) in Hydropower Development in Pakistan and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.
 WAPDA invites eligible consulting firms, as defined in the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (Feb, 2025), to indicate their interest in providing services for "Socio Economic Assessments on Priority E&S Aspects". Interested firms must be duly registered with SECP and PEC, possess a valid NTN with their name appearing on the ATL of FBR, and must not have been blacklisted by any government organization.
 The assignment involves conducting two targeted socio-economic assessments for selected hydropower projects, including survey design, field data collection, assessment of priority E&S risks (land acquisition, resettlement, labor management), institutional strengthening tools, on-the-job training (OJT), and submission of consolidated reports and datasets. The implementation period of this assignment will be 03 Months which is expected to commence in May, 2026.
 Interested firms shall provide information demonstrating relevant qualifications and experience. The Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultant's Qualifications Based Selection (CQS) method set out in WB regulations mentioned above.
 Detailed REOI Document along with comprehensive Terms of Reference (TORs) may be downloaded from WAPDA's Website upto 30.03.2026.
 Expressions of Interest must be delivered in writing (in person) or by courier / mail to the office of General Manager (HRM), WAPDA, 227-WAPDA House, Lahore on or before 31.03.2026 till 1200 hrs. EOls will be opened for evaluation on the same day at 1230 hrs.
 Further information may be obtained from the following address from 1030 to 1300 hours.

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTING SERVICES)

Country: The Republic of Uzbekistan

Implementation Agency: National Agency for Social Protection (NASP) under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan

Name of Project: “Innovative Social Protection System for Inclusion of Vulnerable Populations” (INSON)

Financial Agreement No. 75550-UZ / Grant Agreement No. TF C4589-UZ

Assignment Title: Individual Consultant on Improving the System of Appointment of Guardians or Trustees for Adult Citizens

Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): UZ-INSON-CS-IC- 2.1.10.3

 

The Republic of Uzbekistan has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the “Innovative Social Protection System for Inclusion of Vulnerable Populations” (INSON) project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include an in-depth analysis of the existing legal framework and institutional arrangements governing the appointment of guardians or trustees for adults who require guardianship due to their health condition, as well as persons who are legally incapacitated or have limited legal capacity.

The assignment will include the preparation of recommendations to improve the procedures for appointing guardians or trustees, development of methodological and organizational mechanisms, and proposals aimed at strengthening inter-institutional coordination among relevant government authorities.

The Consultant is expected to prepare analytical and methodological materials, including proposals for improving procedures and standards, including capacity building and training activities for relevant specialists where necessary.

The estimated level of effort is approximately 3 professional staff-months over the duration of the assignment, which is about 16 weeks from the contract start date. The expected start date – April, 2026 (tentatively).

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be found at the following link:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1UW3Q62bTKnehzlCyVlKw8iovCVpjhwTq/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=104755491226149341341&rtpof=true&sd=true

The National Agency for Social Protection (NASP) under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan now invites eligible individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (attach curriculum vitae with description of experience in similar assignments, similar conditions, etc.). Firms’ staff may express interest through the employing firm for the assignment and, under such situation, only the experience and qualifications of individuals shall be considered in the selection process. The criteria for selecting the Consultant are:

Education:

Higher education degree in social protection/social work, psychology, or law.

Experience and Skills:

– At least 5 years of practical experience in adult guardianship/adult protection, case management, and interagency coordination;

– Proven experience in developing and introducing regulatory and methodological documents related to the appointment of guardians/trustees (SoP, RACI, SLA, checklists, complaint/appeal procedures);

– Experience in developing and/or applying court conclusion structures, substantiation procedures, assessment criteria, and decision-making methodologies;

– Experience in organizing comprehensive assessments (psychological, cognitive, and social-functional assessments), including work with ethics and confidentiality (consent, privacy);

– Experience in designing and delivering training/ToT programs, supervision sessions, and capacity-building initiatives within social service networks similar to “Inson,” including training of trainers programs;

– Experience in interagency cooperation with social sector institutions, courts/justice authorities, healthcare institutions, NGOs, and service providers;

– Knowledge of international approaches and standards (World Bank, OECD, ILO, UNICEF; Council of Europe practice on adult guardianship, etc.);

– Experience working with public institutions in Central Asian countries shall be considered an advantage.

Language Requirements:

Proficiency in Russian or Uzbek.

The attention of interested Consultants (including firms) is drawn to paragraph 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, September 2023 (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 09-00 to 18-00 hours (Tashkent time).

Expressions of interest supported by CV must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by mail, or by e-mail) by April 7, 2026.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REOI)

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

 

Country:

Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia

Project:

Horn of Africa Initiative: Regional Economic Corridor Project (Addis-Djibouti Corridor) 

Grant No.:

IDA-E2160

Assignment Title:

Consultancy Services for iRAP Assessment of Addis-Djibouti Road Corridor

Proc. Reference No:

ET-ERA-529354-CS-QCBS

The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Horn of Africa Initiative: Regional Economic Corridor Project (Addis – Djibouti Corridor) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting service (“the Services”) is to conduct a comprehensive iRAP assessment of the 675.7 km Addis-Djibouti Road Corridor to evaluate safety and identify life-saving infrastructure improvements. The assignment involves developing a customized Ethiopia Road Assessment Program framework and performing detailed road surveys using iRAP-accredited equipment to capture video and GPS data. Additionally, the consultant will collect supporting data on traffic volumes, speeds, and georeferenced crash records to generate star ratings and a Safer Roads Investment Plan (SRIP) through the ViDA software system. The project concludes with a feasible action plan, feasibility studies for safety engineering interventions, and a series of stakeholder workshops to ensure the recommendations are practical and evidence-based.

The services will be conducted over a period of 12 Months (twelve months) from the date of effectiveness of the contract (after an issuance of a letter of commencement).

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for these assignments are available on the ERA website alongside this REOI. Interested applicants may also obtain a copy of the TOR at the address provided at the end of this notice.

The Ethiopian Roads Administration (ERA), acting as an implementation agency on behalf of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the services. Interested consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the services. Key experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

The following criteria will be used to assess the Expression of Interest documents:

  • Company Establishment [regarding its Areas of Expertise, Core Business, and Year in the Business]
  • Technical and Managerial Organization of the firm
  • Number and diversity of permanent personnel related to the service
  • Experience completed similar service contracts in the role of prime consultant, JV member, Sub-consultant or management consultant for at least the last ten years:
  • Familiarity, knowledge and experience in the region (in Ethiopia and other Sub-Saharan countries) are an advantage.

The attention of interested consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s PROCUREMENT IN INVESTMENT PROJECT FINANCING, Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services, Sixth Edition, Issued February 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost-Based Selection method set out in the Procurement Regulations. Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours, i.e., 0900 to 1700 hours.

  1. The Electricité Du Laos has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Power Distribution Improvement Project, and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for Design, Supply and Installation of Transformers and Equipment for Substation in Southern Region (Sapaothong, BanNa and Pakbor). For this contract, the Borrower shall process the payments using the Direct Payment disbursement method, as defined in the World Bank’s Disbursement Guidelines for Investment Project Financing, except for those payments, which the contract provides to be made through letter of credit.

2.         The Electricité Du Laos (EDL) now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for Design, Supply and Installation of Transformers and Equipment for Substation in Southern Region (Sapaothong, BanNa and Pakbor), for 180 days delivery period.

3.         Bidding will be conducted through international competitive procurement using a Request for Bids (RFB)  as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” dated November 2020 (“Procurement Regulations”), and is open to all eligible Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations.

4.         Bids will be evaluated in accordance with the evaluation process set out in the bidding documents. The following weightings shall apply for Rated Criteria (including technical and non-price factors): 20 % for technical and for Bid cost: 80 %.

5.         Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from Mr. Lik NAKHONEKHAM, Project Manager, Power Distribution Improvement Project (PDIP) and inspect the bidding document during office hours 09:00 to 17:00 hours at the address given below.

6.         The bidding document in English language may be purchased by interested eligible Bidders upon the submission of a written application to the address below and upon payment of a nonrefundable fee of 2.2 Million Kip or 100 US Dollar. The method of payment will be cross cheque in the name of the Electricité Du Laos. The document will be sent by courier. The EDL will not be responsible for the late delivery or loss of shipment.

7.         Bids must be delivered to the address below on or before 14:30 hours on 6th April 2026. Electronic Bidding will not be permitted. Late Bids will be rejected. All envelopes marked “Second Envelope: Financial Part” shall remain unopened and will be held in safe custody of the Purchaser until the second public opening.

8.         All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid Security of 90,000 US Dollar.

9.         Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the bidding document.

procnotices.notice_text:
Demande de Propositions No : BI-PAFEN-PIU-2.4.1.9-NC-RFB

Émis le : 23 Mars 2026

A : [nom et adresse du Proposant]

Messieurs, Mesdames,

  1. Le Gouvernement de la République du Burundi a obtenu un Don de l’Association Internationale pour le Développement (IDA) pour financer le coût du Projet d’Appui aux Fondations de l’Economie Numérique (PAFEN). Il est prévu qu’une partie des sommes accordées au titre de ce financement sera utilisée pour effectuer les paiements prévus au titre du Marché « Acquisition et mise en place d'un Système Intégré de Gestion des Finances Publiques du Burundi (SIGFP_BI) au profit du Ministère des Finances, du Budget et de l’Economie Numérique (MFBEN) ». 
  2. L’Unité de Gestion du Projet de PAFEN invite, par la présente, les Proposants de pays éligibles à remettre des Propositions sous pli fermé, pour la réalisation de « Acquisition et mise en place d'un Système Intégré de Gestion des Finances Publiques du Burundi (SIGFP_BI) au profit du Ministère des Finances, du Budget et de l’Economie Numérique (MFBEN) ».  L’objectif du MFBEN est la mise en place d’un système intégré de gestion de finances publiques du Burundi (SIGFP_BI) susceptible de prendre en charge les processus clés du cycle budgétaire et d’intégrer les récentes réformes de gestion des finances publiques au Burundi, dont notamment la mise en place d’une budgétisation basée sur les programmes et les résultats.
  3. 3. Le cahier de charges contenu dans la présente Demande de Propositions décrit les besoins métiers et les exigences fonctionnelles et techniques pour « Le Développement et Déploiement d’un Système Intégré de Gestion des Finances Publiques du Burundi (SIGFP_BI), y compris toutes ses composantes, indiquée dans le présent document.  Les technologies utilisées pour la réalisation de SIGFP_BI devront être libres (Open Source) et gratuites. Le développement devra se faire selon une méthodologie agile, par un prestataire de services informatiques. Il interviendra sur place dans les bureaux du MFBEN et devra étroitement intégrer les informaticiens désignés par ce Ministère dans ses équipes. Le SIGFP_BI sera composée de modules logiciels développés sur mesure.
  4. 4. Le Projet doit s’exécuter sur une durée de vingt-quatre (24) mois calendaires à partir de la notification du contrat effectif des prestations prévues dans le cadre contractuel. Cependant, les fonctionnalités doivent être installées et testées d’abord au Ministère des Finances, du Budget et de l‘Economie Numérique (MFBEN) sis au 51, Boulevard du Japon, Nouveau Building des Finances, avant de progresser vers d’autres sites.

Le SIGFP_BI doit pouvoir servir tous les ministères (Administration centrale et déconcentrée) et les institutions constitutionnelles.

5. Les exigences en matière de qualifications sont :

5.1. Capacité financière :

  1. Disposer d’avoirs liquides ou avoir accès à des actifs non grevés ou des lignes de crédit, etc. autres que l’avance de démarrage éventuelle, à des montants suffisants pour subvenir aux besoins de trésorerie nécessaires à l’exécution du marché objet de la présente Demande de Propositions à hauteur d’un montant au moins égal à Cinq Cent Mille (500,000.00) Dollars US ou l’équivalent dans une autre devise librement convertible au taux de change du 15/04/2026 et nets de ses autres engagements. La justification est établie par des déclarations appropriées des banques ou organismes financiers habilités ;
  2. Avoir un Chiffre d’Affaires annuel moyen d’au moins Un Million cinq cents Mille (1,500,000.00) de Dollar US ou l’équivalent dans une autre devise librement convertible, au cours des cinq (05) dernières années fiscales du pays d’origine du soumissionnaire.

5.2. Capacité technique et expérience:

  1.  Avoir réalisé avec succès et preuves à l’appui au moins un (01) marché de développement d’un système intégré de gestion des finances publiques capable de gérer le budget programme, au cours de la période commençant le 1er janvier 2016 à la date de soumission de la proposition, d’une valeur minimale équivalente à Deux Millions (2,000,000.00 US$) de dollars américains. Ce marché devra être prouvé par tous documents attestant la réception définitive (certificats/attestation /PV, etc.) du Maître d’Ouvrage.
  2. Disposer d’un personnel clé remplissant les critères de qualifications et d’expérience exigées par la présente Demande de Propositions.

6. La procédure sera conduite par mise en concurrence internationale en recourant à une Demande de Propositions (AP) telle que définie dans le « Règlement applicable aux Emprunteurs – Passation des Marchés dans le cadre de Financement de Projets d’Investissement », Edition septembre 2023 de la Banque Mondiale (« le Règlement de Passation des Marchés »), et ouverte à tous les Proposants éligibles tels que définis dans le Règlement de Passation de Marchés.

7. Les Offres seront évaluées conformément au processus d'évaluation défini dans le dossier d'appel d'offres. Les pondérations suivantes s'appliqueront aux Critères notés (y compris les facteurs techniques) : 60% et pour le coût de l'Offre : 40%.

8. Les Proposants éligibles intéressés peuvent obtenir des informations supplémentaires et examiner le Dossier de Demande de Propositions dans les bureaux de bureaux de l’Unité de Gestion du Projet d’Appui aux Fondations de l’Economie Numérique (PAFEN) et examiner le Dossier de Demande de Propositions (DDP) durant les heures de bureau de 8 :00 à 17 :00, heure de Bujumbura (GMT+2) à l’adresse indiquée ci-dessous.

9. Le Dossier de Demande de Propositions en Français peut être acheté par tout Proposant éligible intéressé en formulant une demande écrite à l’adresse ci-dessous contre un paiement non remboursable de Cent Dollars Américains (US$ 100.00) ou l’équivalent dans une autre devise librement convertible.

La méthode de paiement sera un dépôt direct de cinquante Dollars Américains (US$ 50.00) ou l’équivalent dans une autre devise librement convertible sur le compte N° 1101/001.04 (sous-compte de transit des recettes non fiscales) ouvert à la Banque de la République du BURUNDI (BRB) au nom de l’Office Burundais des Recettes (OBR) et cinquante Dollars Américains (US$ 50.00) ou l’équivalent dans une autre devise librement convertible sur le compte N°03104582310 ouvert à la Banque de la République du BURUNDI (BRB) au nom du Projet d’Appui aux Fondations de l’Economie Numérique (PAFEN). Le document de demande de proposition sera adressé par voie électronique ou remis main à main au Proposant se présentant au Bureau de l’Unité de Gestion du Projet d’Appui aux Fondations de l’Economie Numérique (PAFEN).

Le code Swift de la Banque de la République du Burundi (BRB) est : BRBUBIBIXXX

10. Les Propositions doivent être livrées à l’adresse ci-dessous au plus tard le 05 Mai 2026 à 10 :00, heure de Bujumbura (GMT+2).  La passation de marchés électronique « ne sera pas » autorisée.   Les Propositions tardives seront rejetées.  Les enveloppes extérieures de la Proposition portant la mention « PROPOSITION ORIGINALE » et les enveloppes intérieures portant la mention « PARTIE TECHNIQUE » seront ouvertes au public en présence des représentants désignés du Proposant et de toute personne qui choisira d’y assister, à l’adresse ci-dessous le même jour, c’est-à dire le 05 Mai 2026 à 10 :15, heure de Bujumbura (GMT+2). Toutes les enveloppes portant la mention « PARTIE FINANCIÈRE » resteront non ouvertes et seront conservées en lieu sûr par l’Acheteur jusqu’à la deuxième ouverture publique des Propositions.

11. Les Propositions doivent être accompagnées d’une déclaration de garantie de proposition.

12. Veuillez noter que le Règlement de Passation des Marchés exige que l’Emprunteur divulgue les informations sur les propriétaires effectifs du Proposant retenu, dans le cadre de l’avis de Notification d’Attribution de Marché, en renseignant le Formulaire de divulgation des bénéficiaires effectifs inclus dans le dossier de demande de propositions.

13. L’adresse mentionnée ci-dessus est :

AGUAS DE MOCAMBIQUE, IP

 

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES - SELECTION OF COMPANIES)

Cyclone Idai and Kenneth Emergency Recovery and Resilience

Project - P171040;

Southern Africa Trade and Connectivity Project - P164847;

Sustainable Energy and Broadband Access in Rural Areas - P175295;

Transport Corridors for Economic Resilience Project - P510427

and

Maputo urban transformation project- P171449

Consultancy Services for Financial Audit of Infrastructure Projects financed by the World Bank. Financial Audit for Fiscal Years 2025 – 2027

Reference. No. (Procurement Plan): MZ-AIAS-530904-CS-QCBS

The Government of Mozambique (GoM) has received from the World Bank fund for Cyclone Idai and Kenneth Emergency Recovery and Resilience Project (P171040); Southern Africa Trade and Connectivity Project (P164847); Sustainable Energy and Broadband Access in Rural Areas Project (P175295); Transport Corridors for Economic Resilience Project – TRACER SOP2 (P510427) and; Maputo Urban Transformation Project (P171449) and intends to apply part of the resources in consulting services for Financial Audit of Infrastructure Projects financed by the World Bank. The requested consultancy services relate to the Financial Audit for Fiscal Years 2025 – 2027 and will be separate on five contracts: (i) Cyclone Idai and Kenneth Emergency Recovery and Resilience Project (P171040); (ii) Southern Africa Trade and Connectivity Project (P164847); (iii) Sustainable Energy and Broadband Access in Rural Areas Project (P175295); (iv) Transport Corridors for Economic Resilience Project – TRACER SOP2 (P510427) and: (v) Maputo Urban Transformation Project (P171449).

Detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for these consultancies can be found on the following website: https://aiasmz.webnode.page/ or   www.aias.gov.mz

Águas de Moçambique, IP now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are:

  1. Core business area in Financial Audit consulting services with a minimum of 10 years of experience;
  2. The auditor must hold a valid professional license (e.g., OCAM in Mozambique or an international equivalent) and demonstrate relevant experience in auditing donor-funded projects;
  3. At least 2 assignments of external financial audits for large-scale investment projects (preferably in infrastructure) completed in the last 5 years, with a significant audited annual disbursement value;
  4. Proven experience in audits following International Standards on Auditing (ISA) and the financial reporting requirements of the World Bank or other international financial institutions;
  5. 3 (three) years of working experience in developing countries, with a particular focus on sub-Saharan Africa. Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage."

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” September 2023, establishing World Bank policy on conflict of interest.

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications, but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected according to the method “QCBS” – Selection Based on Cost Quality established in the Procurement Regulation.

More information can be obtained at the address below, during business hours from 8:00 am to 3:30 pm.

Expressions of interest must be delivered to the address below by April, 08 2026, at 3:30 pm local time and must clearly indicate: “Consultancy Services for Financial Audit of Infrastructure Projects financed by the World Bank. Financial Audit for Fiscal Years 2025 – 2027”.

MINISTERE DE LA SANTE                                                                                 BURKINA FASO

                                                                                                                   La Patrie ou la Mort, nous Vaincrons

SECRETARIAT GENERAL

  DIRECTION DES MARCHES PUBLICS

SERVICE DES MARCHES DE                  

TRAVAUX ET DE PRESTATIONS

         INTELLECTUELLES              

 

Sélection de bureaux ou cabinets d’études pour le recrutement d'un Cabinet pour la réalisation des audits des états financiers du Projet de Renforcement de la Performance de La Résilience du Système de Santé (PRPRSS) pour les exercices (octobre 2025 à décembre 2026),2027,2028.

 

AVIS À MANIFESTATION D’INTÉRÊT N°2026 -0001 /MS/SG/DMP /Smt-pi du 11 mars 2026

 

        

  Réf STEP : BF-PRPRSS-531273-CS-CQS

 

 

(SELECTION DE CONSULTANTS-SELECTION DE FIRMES)

 

 

PAYS : Burkina Faso

 

NOM DU PROGRAMME : PROJET DE RENFORCEMENT DE LA PERFORMANCE DE LA RESILIENCE DU SYSTEME DE SANTE (PRPRSS)

 

 

SECTEUR : Santé

 

SERVICES DE CONSULTANTS : Réalisation des audits des états financiers du Projet de Renforcement de la performance de la Résilience du Système de Santé (PRPRSS) pour les exercices (octobre2025 à 31 décembre 2026), 2027 ,2028.

 

MODE DE FINANCEMENT : Accord de crédit N° 7695-BF &TFC 6804 et TFC6805

 

1. Le Burkina Faso a obtenu un financement de l’Association Internationale de Développement (IDA) pour financer le coût du Projet de Renforcement de la Performance et de la Résilience du Système de Santé (PRPRSS). Le Projet de Renforcement de la Performance et de la Résilience du Système de Santé (PRPRSS) a pour objectif de renforcer la résilience du système de santé et d’améliorer la qualité et l'utilisation des services de santé et de nutrition, en mettant l'accent sur les populations vulnérables et déplacées.  Conformément aux procédures de la Banque mondiale, le projet se propose d’utiliser une partie du montant de ce financement pour effectuer les paiements au titre du marché relatif au recrutement d'un Cabinet pour la réalisation des audits des états financiers du Projet de Renforcement de la Performance de la Résilience du Système de Santé (PRPRSS) pour les exercices 2026 (octobre 2025 au 31 décembre 2026) à 2028 soit trois (03) exercices. 

 

 

 

 

2. L’objectif global de la mission est de permettre d'exprimer une opinion professionnelle indépendante sur la situation financière du Projet à la fin de chaque exercice comptable et de s'assurer que les ressources mises à la disposition du Projet sont utilisées aux fins pour lesquelles elles ont été octroyées en vue de l'atteinte de ses objectifs de développement. Les états financiers du Projet, sont établis par l'Unité de Gestion du projet de manière à rendre compte des transactions financières du Projet. L’Unité de Gestion du projet a en charge de maintenir un système de contrôle interne adéquat ainsi qu'une documentation acceptable des transactions. L'Auditeur devra également formuler une opinion sur l'application correcte des procédures de passation des marchés de la Banque mondiale et de manière conforme aux Accords de Financement.

  1. . Les prestations à réaliser comprennent la vérification de la conformité aux modalités et exigences de gestion financière convenues dans le cadre de la conception du projet. Dans ce cadre, l'auditeur doit apprécier si :

 

  1. toutes les ressources de la Banque et les ressources extérieures (lorsque d’autres bailleurs sont parties prenantes du financement) ont été employées conformément aux dispositions des accords de financement applicables, dans un souci d’économie et d’efficience, et uniquement aux fins pour lesquelles elles ont été fournies ;

 

  1. les fonds de contrepartie nationale (budget de l’Etat) ont été obtenus et employés conformément aux dispositions des accords de financement applicables, dans un souci d’économie et d’efficience, et uniquement aux fins pour lesquelles ils ont été fournis ;

 

  1. les acquisitions des biens et services financés ont fait l’objet de marchés passés conformément aux dispositions des accords de financement applicables fondés sur les procédures de passation de marché de de Banque[1] et ont été proprement enregistrés dans les livres comptables ;

 

  1. tous les dossiers, comptes et écritures nécessaires ont été tenus au titre des différentes opérations relatives au Projet (y compris les dépenses couvertes par des relevés de dépenses ou des rapports de suivi financier). Dans le cas de décaissement sur la base de rapport de suivi financier, l’auditeur vérifiera que les rapports établis pendant la période couverte par l’audit sont conformes avec les accords de financement, sincères, fiables et donnent une image fidèle des transactions demandées en remboursement ;

 

  1. les Comptes Désignés sont gérés eu égard aux dispositions des accords de financement ;

 

  1. les comptes des Projets ont été préparés sur la base de l’application systématique des normes du Système Comptable des entités à but non lucratif et donnent une image fidèle de la situation financière du Projet à la fin de chaque exercice ainsi que des ressources reçues et des dépenses effectuées au cours de l’exercice clos à cette date ;

 

  1. la performance financière globale du projet est satisfaisante ;

 

  1. les actifs immobilisés des Projets sont réels et correctement évalués et le droit de propriété du Projet ou des bénéficiaires sur ces actifs est établi en conformité avec l’accord de financement ;

 

  1. les dépenses inéligibles dans les demandes de remboursement de fonds identifiées lors de l’audit ont été remboursées au Compte Désigné. Ces dépenses feront l’objet d’une note séparée dans le rapport d’audit ;

 

  1. . Les termes de référence (TDRs) détaillés de la mission peuvent être retirés au secretariat DMP/MS

 

 

  1. . Le Directeur des Marchés Publics du Ministère de la Santé, invite les firmes de consultants admissibles et/ou Groupement de Consultants, à manifester leur intérêt à fournir les prestations ci-dessus décrites.
  2. . Les consultants intéressés par cet avis, doivent fournir des informations indiquant qu'ils ont les qualifications et une expérience pertinente pour exécuter lesdites prestations (brochures, références concernant l'exécution des contrats analogues, expérience dans le domaine similaire, expérience dans des conditions semblables, disponibilité des compétences nécessaires, etc.…). Les Consultants peuvent se mettre en association pour augmenter leurs chances de qualification. Le personnel clé ne sera pas évalué lors de l'établissement de la liste restreint.
  3. . La Direction des Marchés Publics du Ministère de la Santé, se réserve le droit de vérifier l'authenticité des informations communiquées.
  4. . Le Cabinet d’audit doit être un Cabinet d’Audit et d’Expertise Comptable indépendant, faisant profession habituelle de réviser les comptes, régulièrement inscrit au Tableau d’un Ordre des Experts-Comptables reconnu au plan international par l’IFAC ou la FIDEF, ayant une expérience confirmée en audit financier des projets de développement et acceptable par l’IDA. Plus spécifiquement, l’auditeur sera un Cabinet d’audit et d’expertise comptable justifiant d’au moins 5 ans d’expériences dans le domaine de l’audit comptable et financier des projets/programmes similaires et doit avoir audité les états financiers annuels de 5 projets au moins financés par la Banque mondiale. Il devra en outre posséder une connaissance suffisante des dispositions administratives et réglementaires au Burkina Faso et des normes internationales en matière d’audit financier et comptable. Le gérant du cabinet doit être un expert-comptable diplômé disposant d’au moins dix (10) années d’expérience professionnelle en audit financier et disposer d’au moins trois collaborateurs techniques permanents ayant plus de 5 ans d'expérience en audit financier (critères éliminatoires).

 

Critères de sélection

 

  • Expérience dans l’audit financier de projets/programmes de développement tout domaine et tout financement compris : 30 points 
  • Expérience en matière d'audit financier de projets/programmes de développement selon les normes de l'IDA : 60 points ;
  • Capacité organisationnelle et structure institutionnelle du cabinet, incluant la structure interne et le personnel permanent mobilisable pour les missions d’audit : 10 points.

En cas d’égalité de points, le consultant (firme) ayant réalisé plus d’expérience en matière d'audit financier de projets/programmes de développement selon les normes de l'IDA sera retenu.

            NB : Les preuves des prestations similaires exécutées soutenues par les copies des pages de garde et de signature des contrats et d’attestations de bonne fin ou des rapports de validation. Seules les références attestées par des pièces justificatives seront prises en compte pour l’évaluation.

9. Le consultant sera sélectionné sur le mode de « Sélection fondée sur les qualifications des consultants (SQC) » conformément aux procédures spécifiées dans le Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissement (FPI) Fournitures, Travaux, Services autres que des Services de Consultants et Services de Consultants de juillet 2016, et sont ouverts à tous les candidats qui remplissent les conditions stipulées dans le Règlement

Les TDRs peuvent y être consultés ou retirés.

 

Les manifestations d'intérêt sous forme écrite en langue française et présentées sous plis fermés en un (01) original et trois (03) copies doivent être déposées en personne à l'adresse mentionnée ci-dessous au plus tard le 02 avril 2026 à 09 heures 00 TU au Secrétariat de la Direction des Marchés Publics du Ministère de la santé sise à l’adresse mentionnée ci-dessus.

DE DJIBOUTI (FAR)

 

AVIS A MANIFESTATION D’INTERÊT

AMI: N°01/AMI/FAR/2026

 

Recrutement d’un Consultant pour la formation aux normes internationales et nationales applicables (ISO 9001, ISO 22000, ISO 17025, ISO 17020, ISO 17065, HACCP) du personnel du laboratoire National d'Analyses Alimentaires (LANAA).

 

 

La République de Djibouti a reçu un crédit de l’Association Internationale de Développement (IDA) pour couvrir le coût du Projet d'Appui aux Filières Agricoles Résilientes de Djibouti (FAR) et a l’intention d’affecter une partie de ce crédit pour effectuer des paiements au titre du Marché pour le recrutement d’un Consultant pour la formation aux normes internationales et nationales applicables (ISO 9001, ISO 22000, ISO 17025, ISO 17020, ISO 17065, ainsi qu’au système HACCP) du personnel du Laboratoire National d'Analyses Alimentaires (LANAA) .

Les consultants individuels spécialisés dans ce domaine et intéressés par cet avis, sont invités à retirer les Termes de Référence (TdRs) à l’adresse mentionnée ci-dessous. ( projet.far.maepe.rh2024@gmail.com )

 

Il est porté à l'attention des Consultants intéressés que les dispositions sur la Section III, les paragraphes 3.14, 3.16 et 3.17 du Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le financement des projets d’investissement (Septembre 2025) exposant la politique de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflits d'intérêts sont applicables.

 

Un Consultant sera sélectionné selon la méthode de « Consultant Individuel » telle que décrite dans les règlements de passation de marchés de la Banque Mondiale, Version 2025, notamment la Section VII. Sélections des Consultants Individuels.

 

Les critères de sélection sont les suivants :

Le consultant devrait posséder les qualifications et l'expérience suivantes :

  • Être titulaire d’un diplôme universitaire de niveau Bac+5 minimum avec spécialisation ou formation en qualité dans le domaine agroalimentaire.
  • Minimum 5 ans d’expérience significative en certification, inspection, validation et vérification dans le domaine de la qualité.
  • Avoir réalisé au moins trois (3) missions/formations relatives aux normes ISO (notamment ISO 22000, ISO 22002, ISO 17025, ISO 17065, ISO 9001), au système HACCP et au Plan de Maîtrise Sanitaire.
  • Expertise démontrée dans l’accompagnement des organisations à la démarche qualité, la mise en place de Systèmes de Management de la Qualité (ISO 22000-18) et la gestion des processus d'accréditation.
  • Expériences techniques spécifiques en normes de biosécurité et en normes sanitaires internationales dans le secteur de l’agroalimentaire.
  • Avoir une connaissance et une expérience des réalités du secteur commerce et qualité au niveau de la Corne de l’Afrique et en Djibouti est un atout

O Governo de Moçambique (GdM), através do Ministério das Finanças recebeu um financiamento do Banco Mundial para o custo do Projecto de Ligações Económicas para a Diversificação: Conecta Negócios e pretende aplicar parte dos recursos em Serviços de Consultoria Juridica para Apoiar na Constituição do Bureau de Convenções de Moçambique – Sector do Turismo.

  • Concepção de instrumentos normativos para institucionalização e funcionamento do Bureau de Convenções de Moçambique, em conformidade com a Estratégia de MICE aprovada pelo Governo de Moçambique, documentos conexos e legislação aplicável;
  • Adequação dos instrumentos normativos do INATUR I.P. para os objetivos pretendidos com o presente concurso, incluindo a nova perspectiva para a conversão do INATUR IP, em Agência Nacional de Desenvolvimento e Investimentos do Turismo;

Os termos de referência (TOR) detalhados para a Consultoria podem ser encontrados no endereço abaixo ou podem ser fornecidos mediante solicitação para o seguinte e-mail: procurement.pled@gmail.com.

3. O Ministério das Finanças (MF) convida as empresas de consultoria (“Consultores”) elegíveis para indicar seu interesse em fornecer os Serviços. Os consultores interessados ​​devem fornecer informações que demonstrem que possuem as qualificações exigidas e a experiência relevante para prestar os serviços (brochuras, descrição de contratos semelhantes, experiência em condições semelhantes, etc).  

Os critérios de avaliação para a lista curta são os seguintes:

  • Carta de apresentação;
  • Experiência comprovada da firma (mínimo, 10 anos de exercício);
  • Documento que comprova que a empresa não se encontra suspensa ou em situação irregular, passado pela Ordem dos Advogados de Moçambique;
  • Conhecimento de normas aplicáveis ao sector de turismo e à criação de entidades como bureau de convenções.
  • Experiência comprovada para a estruturação de pelo menos 2 entidades público-privadas a nível nacional incluindo a elaboração de estatutos, pareceres jurídicos e apoio na formalização institucional.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos na elaboração de propostas para parcerias público-privadas (PPPs) ou modelos de governança colaborativa entre governo e sector privado.

Nesta fase a Equipa Chave não será objecto de avaliação para a Lista Curta.

4. Chama-se a atenção dos Consultores interessados ​​para a Seção III, parágrafos 3.14, 3.16 e 3.17 do "Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários do IPF" do Banco Mundial, Novembro de 2020 ("Regulamento de Aquisições"), que estabelece a política do Banco Mundial sobre conflito de interesses.

Os consultores podem se associar a outras firmas para reforçar as suas qualificações, mas devem indicar claramente se a associação é na forma de Associação/ou subcontratação. No caso de Associados, todos os integrantes serão solidariamente responsáveis pela totalidade do contrato, se selecionados.

5. O consultor será selecionado de acordo com método de selecção baseada nas Qualificações do Consultor (CQS), estabelecido no Regulamento de Aquisições do Banco Mundial.

6. O Projecto de Ligações Económicas para Diversificação promove um ambiente de trabalho onde prevalece a igualdade de direitos e o respeito à dignidade de mulheres e homens. A Exploração Abuso e Assédio sexual (EAAS) contra os beneficiários, comunidades e colaboradores do projeto não são tolerados. Espera-se que os candidatos a esta consultoria cumpram os princípios, regulamentos e medidas do Banco Mundial que regem a prevenção e mitigação da Violência Baseada no Género e Exploração Abuso e Assédio Sexual.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTING SERVICES)

Country: The Republic of Uzbekistan

Implementation Agency: National Agency for Social Protection (NASP) under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan

Name of Project: “Innovative Social Protection System for Inclusion of Vulnerable Populations” (INSON)

Financial Agreement No. 75550-UZ / Grant Agreement No. TF C4589-UZ

Assignment Title: Senior International Consultant on Development of Community-Based Social Services and Guardianship Systems

Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): UZ-INSON-CS-IC-2.1.3.1.

 

The Republic of Uzbekistan has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the “Innovative Social Protection System for Inclusion of Vulnerable Populations” (INSON) project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include providing strategic, technical and methodological support to the National Agency for Social Protection (NASP) in the development and piloting of community-based social services and strengthening of guardianship systems. The assignment will support the ongoing reform of social services aimed at shifting from institutional care models toward modern community-based and person-centered services.

The Consultant will provide expert support in the following areas: development of community-based services for children in difficult life situations; strengthening guardianship, trusteeship and adoption systems; development of community-based services for persons with disabilities and support to deinstitutionalization processes; and improvement of services for vulnerable adults, including victims of violence and trafficking.

The estimated level of effort is approximately 120 person-days over a period of about 9 months from contract start. The assignment will combine home-based analytical work with field missions in Uzbekistan. The expected start date is April 2026.

https://docs.google.com/document/d/18Z4WgrOFhiIOKByQL6R7jC5nvykfVQFS/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=104755491226149341341&rtpof=true&sd=true

The National Agency for Social Protection (NASP) under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan now invites eligible individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (attach curriculum vitae with description of experience in similar assignments, similar conditions, etc.). Firms’ staff may express interest through the employing firm for the assignment and, under such situation, only the experience and qualifications of individuals shall be considered in the selection process. The criteria for selecting the Consultant are:

Education and academic qualifications: Advanced university degree in public administration, social work, public health, law, or a related field.

Professional experience: At least 10 years of professional experience in social services reform, child protection, disability services, guardianship systems, deinstitutionalization or related areas.

Experience in development of social services models and standards: Proven experience in developing service standards, methodological guidelines, case management systems or community-based service models.

Experience working with governments and international organizations: Experience working with government institutions and international development organizations (World Bank, UNICEF, EU, UN agencies or similar) will be considered an advantage.

International experience: Proven experience working in countries with social, institutional and cultural contexts similar to those of Uzbekistan.

The attention of interested Consultants (including firms) is drawn to paragraph 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, September 2023 (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 09-00 to 18-00 hours (Tashkent time).

procnotices.notice_text:
Request for Expression of Interest (REOI)

 

COUNTRY:                              Republic of Lebanon

PROJECT NAME:                    Fiscal Management Project (FMP)

CONSULTING SERVICES:      Financial Management Specialist

DUTY STATION:                     Ministry of Finance  

  1. The Government of Lebanon has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Fiscal Management Project (FMP). The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is seeking to use part of the proceeds of the funds to finance the position of the Financial Management Specialist.

 

  1. The Financial Management Specialist will have the primary responsibility to support the financial management and financial reporting of all project activities under the FMP, including monitoring the financial progress of the project and ensuring compliance with World Bank financial management requirements.

 

  1. Responsibilities: The Financial Management Specialist will support the financial management of the project by assisting in the preparation of project budgets and financial plans, monitoring project expenditures, and maintaining accurate financial records. The role includes preparing financial reports, supporting the preparation of withdrawal applications, coordinating with the Ministry of Finance and relevant departments on financial matters, and ensuring compliance with applicable financial management procedures and reporting requirements of the World Bank. The Financial Management Specialist will also support audit processes, maintain proper documentation of financial transactions, and contribute to strengthening financial controls within the Project Coordination Unit (PCU). Across all these functions, the Financial Management Specialist will ensure transparency, accuracy, and compliance with World Bank financial management guidelines and applicable government procedures. All other tasks detailed in the Terms of Reference (TOR) that will be provided upon request by E-mail.

 

  1. Duration: The assignment will be for a period of twelve (12) months with the possibility of extension subject to satisfactory performance and availability of fund for the duration of the project.

 

  1. Selection Criteria: The selection shall be based on the qualifications, experience and skills of the candidate and followed by an interview. The qualifications, experience and skills should include:
